caption: A salt shaker is shaken over a plate of fries and salt grains fall onto the fries.

sa.check: A salt shaker is held over a plate of fries.
Salt grains fall onto the fries.
The shake comes first and the fall follows.

pc.expect: Grains fall from the holes straight down onto the fries and plate.
pc.fail: They hang in the air; or fall upward; or drift sideways.

pc.expect: Grains fall as separate specks during each shake, not as a stream or lump.
pc.fail: Salt pours as a solid rod; or as liquid; or as one lump.

pc.expect: Grains fall only during each shake.
pc.fail: Grains fall with the shaker still; or the shake produces nothing; or grains keep falling after the shake stops.

pc.expect: Salt on the fries only accumulates.
pc.fail: It vanishes; or it is there before the shake; or it jumps.

pc.expect: One shaker, and salt comes only from it.
pc.fail: Salt appears with no shaker above; or the shaker duplicates; or salt passes through the shaker.

pc.expect: The shaker, the plate and the fries stay the same.
pc.fail: The shaker changes; or the plate changes; or the fries rearrange.
